name: Koh Lanta to Khao Sok

seo.title: Koh Lanta to Khao Sok Private Minivan | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan between Koh Lanta and Khao Sok or Cheow Lan Pier, both directions, door to door. Cash to the driver. Price on WhatsApp.

h1: Koh Lanta to Khao Sok by private minivan
lead: From your hotel on Koh Lanta to Khao Sok village or Cheow Lan Pier, and back, in a private minivan.

facts.label: Drive time
facts.value: About 4 to 5 hours, depending on traffic

facts.label: Pickup and drop-off
facts.value: Your hotel on Koh Lanta, Khao Sok village, Cheow Lan Pier

faq.q: Do you drive to Cheow Lan Pier?
faq.a: Yes. Cheow Lan Pier is among the places we drive to. Write it as the drop-off, with the time of your boat.

photos.alt: Minivan interior with diamond-stitched tan leather seats and a lit ceiling
photos.shot: Real photo of the VIP Taxi Lanta minivan, shared by every route page today: one photo per route later if possible.

legacyText.title: Koh Lanta to Khao Sok Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
body: We drive to Khao Sok village and to Cheow Lan Pier, where the boats to the lake leave. Tell us which one and your boat time if you have one.
